Hi Sofia / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can map the right stakeholders and keep momentum:  

Call recap (very short):
- Use case: real-time personalization and search re-ranking across web + mobile catalog
- Main constraints: latency 50–100ms p95, data residency in US, SOC 2/contracting required
- Expected initial throughput: ~10 reqs/s per region, scale to ~100 reqs/s in Q1 2027

To move to procurement & legal, could you share the following by EOD next Tue (Aug 18)?
1) A simple approver/authority list or org chart that shows who: economic buyer, contract approver, procurement owner, and security/legal reviewer — we included a short template to make it easy (attached).
2) Preferred contracting flow: PO -> redlined SOW -> who signs (name + title + email).
3) Any mandatory compliance docs we should prepare now (e.g., SOC 2, DPA, vendor questionnaire) and the owner for each.

Attachments: approval-template.xlsx (simple column-based template), redwood-one-pager.pdf

If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute intro call next week to loop in procurement & legal. Proposed slots: Tue 8/19 9:00–9:30 PT or Wed 8/20 11:00–11:30 PT. Let me know which works and I’ll calendar.

Thanks — appreciate the quick help on this.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor

Neha / Monica — looping in from legal. Thanks for the summary. A few notes from our side:  

- Preferred contracting: DocuSign for signature; PO accepted for procurement-managed purchases. For anything that requires redlines, Legal will own the review.
- Compliance docs needed up front: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a vendor DPA, and answers to a short vendor security questionnaire (I’ll send our standard form).
- Timeline: once we have SOC 2 + DPA agreements in principle, procurement typically needs ~2 weeks for PO processing; legal redlines can add 1–2 weeks depending on scope. Plan for ~3 weeks total if no major redlines.

I attached a short SOC2 summary this morning for reference. Monica — if you can share the slide deck before Tue’s call that would help accelerate questions.

Best,
